meta.title: Optimize GitHub Actions frontend-ci workflow for 2-minute target
meta.body_summary: Optimize GitHub Actions frontend-ci workflow to reduce execution time from 5m 3s to under 2 minutes by parallelizing jobs, replacing Supabase with PostgreSQL service, adding Turbo cache, and optimizing pnpm install.

perf_labels.notes: Devin proposed CI workflow optimizations with expected time savings; no human review, closed after ~4 days with no merge.

core_change_summary.description: Modify .github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml to split the frontend-ci job into parallel unit and integration test jobs, add PostgreSQL service container instead of full Supabase startup, enable Turbo cache, add pnpm --ignore-scripts, and reduce timeouts. Also update .github/actions/pnpm-setup/action.yml and turbo.json.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: turbo.json and pnpm-setup action are minor tweaks to enable caching and skip scripts.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: implement job parallelization, PostgreSQL service, turbo cache, pnpm optimization.
Subsequent commits address CI failures: add Supabase CLI install, fix PostgreSQL port, add CSS module type gen for lint.
